comment: The Backblaze Drive Stats quarter every build ships as its fleet AFR table (ROADMAP M5.4, D13). tools/fetch_backblaze.py downloads it at build time, refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the pinned one, and turns it into rates-backblaze-<version>.json. With sha256 null the build ships no fleet table and prints the download's hash for pinning. Drive Fusion itself never downloads anything.
pinned_from: first download, CI run 40986166224 (Backblaze publishes no checksum or signature)
